transcript:
Agent: Hi there! Thank you for calling TechSavvy Solutions. This is Jordan. How can I assist you today?

Customer: Hi Jordan, this is Lisa. I’m having trouble accessing my account. I think I need to reset my password.

Agent: I’d be happy to help you with that, Lisa. Can you please provide me with the email address associated with your account?

Customer: Sure, it’s lisa@example.com. I tried the 'Forgot Password' option, but I didn't receive any email.

Agent: I understand that can be frustrating. Let me check if there are any issues with our system. One moment, please.

Customer: Okay, thanks. I also need to make sure my billing cycle wasn't affected by this problem.

Agent: Thank you for your patience, Lisa. I can confirm that your current billing cycle is active and shouldn’t be impacted. I see the email issue here, though. 

Customer: Oh, that's a relief! So what’s the next step for the password reset?

Agent: I can manually trigger a password reset email for you. You should receive it within a few minutes. Can you check your spam folder just in case?

Customer: Alright, I’ll keep an eye on that. By the way, I've been thinking about upgrading to the Pro plan. What features does it include?

Agent: Great choice! The Pro plan offers advanced analytics, priority customer support, and a higher storage limit. It can really enhance your experience.

Customer: That does sound appealing. How much more is it compared to my current plan?

Agent: The Pro plan is $30 more per month than your current Standard plan, but I can offer a 10% discount if you upgrade today.

Customer: Hmm, that’s tempting. Can you send me the details while I wait for the email?

Agent: Absolutely! I'll send you an email detailing the Pro plan features and that discount offer shortly.

Customer: Thank you so much, Jordan. I appreciate your help!

Agent: You're very welcome, Lisa! If you have any more questions, please don’t hesitate to reach out. Have a great day!

Customer: You too, thanks again!
